collection.title: BMW 3 Series Touring 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 3 Series Touring 2019 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the wiper blade to the arm.

image.alt: BMW 3 Series Touring 2019 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
